title: Retrieval is keyed by the task (S9)
body:
Source: Fable architecture decision 2026-11-15, docs/program/plan.md S9 (Sector 3 — Retrieval (ADR 0020; items 1–3)); program t-b160jt0.

Outcome: session and lane packets query by task title, Outcome, Files, stack and paths; no task means no standards block; AGENTS.md duplicates are not served; audience honoured
